release_notes: Persistent PositionEngine (Phase A of `plan-fast-monitor`) — a per-position background monitor that replaces the periodic full-scan tick for engines opted in, with an engine-status UI, a config-save confirmation when it would restart a running engine, and hardened archive/delete guards. `exit_confirm_sec` — per-strategy Config-modal param requiring an exit condition to hold across a confirmation window before firing, filtering tick noise. Enabled `position_engine` for Kite (dev). Profit-taking exits now gate on leg liquidity — previously a leg with no live quote could still be treated as closed, booking phantom close P&L. Throttled the persistent engine's `monitor` event, which could flood the event log. Breeze rate-limit test pollution and an OS-dependent path-traversal guard in tests. A weak wait in the composer rename E2E test that could flake.
